sys_script_include.description: Builds the current user's 360-degree compensation context (profile, plans, quota, statements, payouts, earning/lookup rules, plan structure, and QTD/YTD performance). Identity is always derived server-side from the logged-in user (gs.getUserID) — no cross-user data is accessible. Consumed by the orchestrator to ground the advisor's answers in real IncentIQ data.
sys_script_include.name: IncentIQ360ContextService
